title: EverydayScience BeverageCooling

stats.done_summary: Successfully completed the beverage cooling analysis. Fitted Newton's Law of Cooling model to 200 temperature measurements (85°C to 31°C over 199 minutes). The exponential decay model provided excellent fit (R² = 0.9785) with cooling constant k = 0.00818 min⁻¹, time constant τ = 122.3 minutes, and inferred ambient temperature of 17.9°C. Two data discontinuities were identified and documented. All deliverables produced: analysis code, figures, and comprehensive research report.
